description: Speed up or slow down audio or video while adjusting timestamps. Audio tempo changes preserve pitch within the supported range. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: media_speed
title: Change playback speed
